title: rhodiola coccinea
intro: Rhodiola coccinea, commonly known as the red root, is a perennial plant in the saxifragaceae family, native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its adaptogenic properties, which help the body to adapt to physical and mental stress, and its potential health benefits include reducing fatigue, improving mood, and enhancing cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Rhodiola coccinea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties. Regular consumption of Rhodiola coccinea may also help to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and boost immune function.
